In [[geometry]], this [[uniform polyhedron compound]] is a composition of 5 [[cuboctahedron|cuboctahedra]]. It has [[Icosahedral symmetry|icosahedral]] symmetry ''I<sub>h</sub>''. It could also be called the anticosicosahedron.

== Cartesian coordinates ==
[[Cartesian coordinates]] for the vertices of this compound are all the cyclic permutations of

: (±2, 0, ±2)
: (±τ, ±τ<sup>−1</sup>, ±(2τ−1))
: (±1, ±τ<sup>−2</sup>, ±τ<sup>2</sup>)

where τ = (1+{{radic|5}})/2 is the [[golden ratio]] (sometimes written φ).

== Construction ==
The compound of 5 cuboctahedra could be made by the [[rectification (geometry)|rectification]] of the [[compound of five cubes]] or [[compound of five octahedra]]. It could also be formed by the [[expansion (geometry)|expansion]] of the compound of [[compound of five tetrahedra|five]] or [[compound of ten tetrahedra|ten]] [[tetrahedron|tetrahedra]].
